subject: Class 323 in West Midlands Railway livery
method: Side elevation from the Chiltern006 WMR diagram (dia), whose two axes are drawn at different scales and are calibrated separately; front measured head-on on pcov with a symmetric projective fit; colours from p214 normalised to its silver bodyside.

calibration.notes: Horizontal: cab car 27..1700 px = 22.81 m and car 2 1757..3411 px = 22.84 m (published body lengths) -> 73.3/72.4 px/m; but bogie centres 1128 px apart (published 16.0 m) and wheels 59 px (0.84 m) give 70.5 px/m, so the drawn bogies are 2.7% close together: positions are taken as fractions of the drawn car, bogie spacing from the published figure. Vertical: rail 348 to roof 40 = 308 px for 3.769 m -> 81.7 px/m, 13% more than horizontally: the drawing is stretched vertically.

trace.heights: dia col 488/1000: orange line rows 71-73 (3.39-3.37 m), body bottom row 266 (1.00 m), cab windows rows 112-179 (2.89-2.07 m), saloon dark panel to row 227 (1.48 m), at 81.7 px/m vertical from the rail at row 348
trace.cab.doors[0]: Camera match (classes/323/match/p214.json): with the camera solved from eight bodyside points alone (rms 5.2 px), the cab door's picked edges back-project to 0.74 m (front, low) and 1.73-1.79 m (rear) along the side: 0.1-0.2 m further back than the diagram's 0.52-1.65 m, which the earlier 1D fit along the window line had seemed to confirm. Moved to 0.70-1.76 m, leaving 0.43 m of body between the corner and the door (review: 'the door is right at the front'). Window a narrow slot 0.50 m wide, centred
trace.cab.doors[1..2]: dia row 200: 455-582 and 1164-1291 px; leaves 62 px; door windows 472-505/532-565 px (0.183-0.634 m from centre), rows 96-181; door rows 74-265
trace.bogies: published 16.0 m over bogie centres (Wikipedia), centred where the diagram centres them (11.52 m on the cab car)
trace.nose.profile: dia: leftmost drawn pixel per row 46-326, x at 73.3 px/m from 27 px, y at 81.7 px/m
trace.face: pcov head-on, symmetric 1D projective fit (c = -1.1e-4): edges +-1.40 m; vertical scale from roof (sy 75 = 3.769 m) to the yellow's foot (sy 1005 = 0.99 m, the diagram's valance top) is 0.002988 m/sx against 0.003005 horizontally: the two agree to 0.6%
trace.face.surround: pcov sx 135/905, sy 255-775: one black band, outer corners rounded, split by a yellow divider sx 525-548 (+-0.035 m) with the wiper bar at sy 662-690
trace.face.lamps: pcov boxes sx 125-328 / 745-915, sy 885-995: a yellow box with a dark rim, headlamp (clear) outboard, tail (red LED) inboard, same size, same height; f-lamps-l-cov, f-lamps-r-cov, f-lamps-r-210 agree; each lamp sits in its own black ring inside the yellow box (lamps pairs, first render had one pill-shaped recess)
trace.face.number: p219 '323219' and p210 '323210' black, centred low between the lamp boxes
trace.face.wiper: pcov and p219: both wipers park up towards the centre divider, mirrored
trace.livery: p214 samples normalised to its silver car side taken as #C8C8C8 (silver-214): gold #B76009 (gold-214), door gold #B3611A (door-214), valance #636171, logo panel #4C464A; face yellow raw from pcov (#FFD823) as no neutral is on the face
trace.livery.shards: dia: the grey zone's left edge per row and each gold diamond as a connected component (top, right, bottom, left points) in 345-454 px; the photos (p214, p210) show the zone white/silver, not the diagram's grey ; drawn with sharp points (radius 0.02/0.015 m) after reader 2 called the first render's diamonds rounded blobs
trace.livery.goldTo: dia row 200: gold to 355 px (4.46 m), the zone to door 1 at 454 px
trace.next.pantograph: dia roof rows 20-36: pantograph base 1980-2045 px on car 2 (3.3 m from its inner end); p210 shows it at car 2's end next to the cab car. The old data had it mid-car (11.4 m)
trace.livery.valance: second reader: cool blue-grey slate; between the raw samples (#4A4C4B, #45444F) and the diagram's #4B4860, cooled
trace.livery.panel: second reader (323 pairs): the band is neutral charcoal; the normalised p214 sample (#4C464A) rendered plum. Raw darkband-210 #282826 and the reader agree on a neutral dark grey
trace.livery.face: pcov raw #FFD823 rendered lemon beside the photos (reader 2: deeper amber-gold); set to a warmer warning yellow
trace.cab.doors[0].panes: dia cols 87-128: the cab door's window is a tall narrow slot (0.56 m wide), not the whole leaf (reader 2, cab-side)
trace.form: The cab corner: pcov head-on, the face's curve starts about 0.15 m in from the silhouette (the screen surround stops at 1.155 m, the edge at 1.40 m); the side diagram shows the corner 0.15-0.27 m deep with the yellow on it. The pipeline's default corner (0.22 m deep, squareness 6, so curving over ~0.28 m) put the cab door's front edge and grab rail at the bend (review of the close render; bodyside check: 23 mm onto the corner at the door top). The door stays where both the diagram (0.52-1.65 m) and a projective fit along 323214's window line (0.44-1.60 m, from six window edges, residuals under 0.05 m) put it
trace.face.vertical: Camera match on p214 (side-only camera, rms 5.2 px; then a search of the lamps' height in the full solve, rms 20.6 -> 12.6 px at +0.25 m) put the lamps 0.25 m higher than the first face reading. That reading had anchored pcov's vertical scale on the yellow's foot taken as 0.99 m (the bodyside's bottom), but the front valance is taller (the diagram's nose column has the valance from 1.54 m). Every face height re-scaled from the roof: y' = 3.769 - 0.896 (3.769 - y), which puts the lamp centres at 1.44 m and the valance top at 1.28 m
